selection_rule: Prefer lower foil escalations on proposed labels without clearing proposed violations on the primary cards condition. Document any remaining prose miss.
why_v4: On DEV cards, v4 cuts foil escalations relative to v0/v1 (11→8) while keeping all 10 proposed violations. Prose foil escalations also fall (12→7) but clear inj-0016 once. v2 had stronger foil cuts but cleared inj-0016 on both conditions. Proposed labels are not gold.
test_policy: Report test_steps.jsonl once with frozen v4. Do not iterate the prompt on test.
